note: Zone HOLDOUT of hexw.io.paths: source files of the holdout publications. Paths are relative to the project root. Blocked for hexw.theory/params/dft/structures/spin/util; readable only by hexw.validate after the freeze and by hexw.audit. literature_holdout/ is always part of the zone and need not be listed. L01 is blocked as a WHOLE publication (its Mg/Ni data are available only through literature/fit). L11 is a FIT source and is not listed. Stage 3 round 1 (2026-10-26): dft_feasibility/pilots/c_W92 and make_bw.py are derivatives of the L01 Zn HRPT CIF (geometry of the holdout sample) and are declared as holdout; the files stay where they are (results of the resource pilots).

publications.L01: Morch 2019, 10.1107/S2052252519003130 (Co, Zn holdout: same_group_reproducibility; Mg, Ni fit)
publications.dft_feasibility/pilots/cif: working copies of the L01 SrCo2Fe16O27 / SrZn2Fe16O27 HRPT CIFs (holdout geometry)
publications.dft_feasibility/pilots/c_W92: derivative of the L01 SrZn2Fe16O27 HRPT CIF: models, QE inputs/outputs of the W-type resource pilot (made by pilots/make_bw.py)
publications.dft_feasibility/pilots/make_bw.py: generator of the c_W92 pilot: carries the L01 Zn HRPT cell and coordinates as literals
publications.lit_search/results/rows_final.json: search-result rows with per-paper annotations (field u: what each paper reports, including holdout papers); the annotations of the holdout publications are holdout content, so the file is blocked as a whole (it is NOT a theory-side source)
publications.lit_search/results/rows_stage2.json: intermediate search rows with per-paper annotations (abstract-derived), including the holdout papers
publications.lit_search/results/merged.json: merged search hits with abstracts of all found papers, including the holdout papers
publications.lit_search/results/raw_hits.json: raw API hits with abstracts (search pass 1), including the holdout papers
publications.lit_search/results/raw_hits2.json: raw API hits with abstracts (search pass 2), including the holdout papers
publications.lit_search/results/raw_hits3.json: raw API hits with abstracts (search pass 3), including the holdout papers
publications.lit_search/results/raw_hits4.json: raw API hits with abstracts (search pass 4), including the holdout papers
publications.lit_search/results/coverage_from_abstrac: per-paper coverage derived from abstracts, including the holdout papers
publications.lit_search/results/coverage_matrix.csv: coverage matrix of the corpus derived from abstracts, including the holdout papers
publications.lit_search/results/review_list.txt: screening list with abstract-derived notes on every paper, including the holdout papers
publications.lit_search/results/merged_list.txt: listing of the merged hits with abstract-derived notes, including the holdout papers
publications.lit_search/results/build_out.txt: per-paper screening summary (abstract-derived flags), including the holdout papers
publications.lit_search/results/candidates.csv: catalogue of found publications WITH reason / topic_tags derived from the abstracts (holdout content for the holdout papers); the cleaned copy lit_search/results/candidates_meta.csv (bibliography only) is allowed

reference_allowlist_note: Files outside vault/ and literature_holdout/ that may name holdout sources (paths / file names) without being holdout themselves: the declaration, the guard and the split code, tests, the documents (reference_allowlist, patterns). graphify-out/ is the generated knowledge-graph index and registry/files_manifest.csv, zip_entries.json inventory raw files by name/hash: names only, no data. reference_allowlist_sha256 lists files that may name a holdout source ONLY while their bytes are identical to the pinned sha256 (hexw audit checks the match): the search-pipeline scripts lit_search/scripts/*.py (they name the declared result files as input/output), the cleaned catalogue lit_search/results/candidates_meta.csv (id, doi, title, authors, year, venue, relevance, oa_status, downloaded_file, sha256: no reason/topic_tags/abstract-derived fields) and documents that cite the catalogue. Stage 4 round 1 (2026-10-26): the search results that contain abstracts or annotations of the holdout papers (rows_final/rows_stage2/merged/raw_hits*/coverage_*/review_list/merged_list/build_out/candidates.csv) are declared holdout; the full candidates.csv is blocked, theory code must not use it.

generated_fit_provenance_review.scope: Exact historical material.json hashes only. The matching filenames are citations copied from permitted FIT excerpts for Mg/Ni; no full mixed-publication CIF was read. New forecasts retain detailed locator pointers in FIT records instead of copying those filenames. Protected-source classification and read restrictions unchanged.
